assumptions: Dates use September 3-16, 2026 as the working plan.

Costs are planning estimates for lodging, local transport, food, activities, and parking/fees. International/domestic airfare is included as a range in the total but cannot be finalized without a departure airport.
Stays are selected target properties. A live availability and cancellation-policy pass should happen before booking.

trips.name: Austria + Alpine Borders
trips.bookability: Strong once flights and Stanglwirt availability are checked
trips.positioning: A three-base alpine farm, spa, and mountain-lift trip that most closely recreates the Switzerland feeling while staying in new places.

bases.name: Munich arrival
bases.reason: Recover from overnight travel before moving with baby and luggage.

bases.name: Wilder Kaiser / Tyrol
bases.reason: The farm-plus-luxury-spa anchor: children's farm, pools, animals, mountain views.

bases.name: Lech / Arlberg
bases.reason: Food-forward alpine base with lift-assisted hikes and a polished village feel.

bases.name: Bavaria / Berchtesgaden
bases.reason: Mountain resort close to Königssee, farms, salt mine, and Munich return.

days.title: Fly overnight to Munich
days.travel: Home airport to Munich, ideally one connection or nonstop if available.
days.morning: Depart with stroller, carrier, car-seat plan, and one checked duffel strategy.
days.afternoon: Keep first day intentionally empty; baby sleep management is the activity.
days.baby: Book bassinet row if available or price an extra seat with FAA-approved car seat.
days.booking: Need departure airport to price flights; target arrival before noon on Sep 4.

days.title: Arrive Munich and reset
days.travel: Walk from terminal to hotel; no car yet.
days.morning: Land, immigration, bags, check in or store luggage.
days.afternoon: Nap, stroller walk in airport plaza, simple grocery/snack run.
days.dinner: Early dinner at hotel or airport restaurants.
days.baby: No sightseeing; protect sleep and reduce first-day transit friction.
days.booking: Book refundable airport hotel for one night.

days.title: Drive to Stanglwirt via easy Tyrol arrival
days.travel: Pick up rental car; Munich to Going am Wilden Kaiser is about 1.5-2 hours without stops.
days.morning: Breakfast, pick up rental car with baby seat, drive after first nap.
days.afternoon: Check in, visit children's farm, pool, and property grounds.
days.baby: First animal encounter and crawl time on resort grounds.
days.booking: Reserve family room; request crib, kettle, fridge, and dinner time.

days.title: Stanglwirt farm and gentle Ellmau day
days.travel: Local driving only, under 20 minutes total.
days.morning: Children's farm, Lipizzaner horses, relaxed breakfast.
days.afternoon: Ellmau village walk and Astberg/Going area if weather is good.
days.baby: Short outings with long resort breaks.
days.booking: Book spa treatment in advance; trade off parent time during nap.

days.title: Hexenwasser and lift-assisted mountain play
days.travel: Short drive to Söll lift area.
days.morning: Hexenwasser mountain adventure world via lift; sensory water paths and easy paths.
days.afternoon: Nap back at resort, pool/spa split.
days.baby: Carrier recommended for lift/mountain paths; stroller only for paved sections.
days.booking: Check Wilder Kaiser lift operating dates before final booking.

days.title: Kufstein fortress and wellness afternoon
days.travel: About 35 minutes each way to Kufstein.
days.morning: Kufstein old town and fortress for culture without a long hike.
days.afternoon: Return for nap, spa, and farm time.
days.baby: Good bad-weather day; fortress/old town can be shortened.
days.booking: Prebook fortress tickets only if needed; keep flexible.

days.title: Transfer to Lech with Innsbruck lunch stop
days.travel: Going to Lech is about 3.5 hours driving, split by Innsbruck.
days.morning: Drive to Innsbruck; old town stroller walk and lunch.
days.afternoon: Continue to Zug/Lech, check into Rote Wand.
days.baby: Break drive into two nap-friendly legs.
days.booking: Reserve room with crib and confirm dinner seating.

days.title: Lech village, river path, and gourmet base day
days.travel: Local walking/shuttle.
days.morning: Lech River path, village, playground/cafe stops.
days.afternoon: Pool/spa and nap; optional short lift ride if weather is clear.
days.baby: Low-transit day after transfer.
days.booking: Ask hotel for stroller-friendly walk map and high chair.

days.title: Formarinsee or Spullersee scenic day
days.travel: Local bus/taxi depending seasonal access.
days.morning: Scenic lake excursion with carrier walk and picnic.
days.afternoon: Return early; nap and quiet hotel time.
days.baby: Carrier day; avoid committing to long lake loop.
days.booking: Confirm local bus schedule and lake access for September.

days.title: Cheese, village life, and parent spa turn-taking
days.travel: Local only.
days.morning: Visit local alpine dairy/cheese stop if available; slow village morning.
days.afternoon: Spa or sauna turn-taking; baby nap and play time.
days.dinner: Splurge dinner at Rote Wand; Chef's Table only if childcare/pace works.
days.baby: Keep the day flexible; food-focused, not hike-focused.
days.booking: Reserve special dinner in advance or skip for baby-friendly dining.

days.title: Transfer to Berchtesgaden via scenic Bavaria
days.travel: Lech to Berchtesgaden is about 4 hours plus stops.
days.morning: Early drive, stop near Füssen or Chiemsee depending baby rhythm.
days.afternoon: Arrive, check in, mountain-view pool/spa.
days.baby: Longest drive day; build in two breaks and no sightseeing pressure.
days.booking: Reserve room with crib; confirm parking and breakfast.

days.title: Königssee and alpine village day
days.travel: Short drive to Königssee.
days.morning: Königssee lakeside walk and optional boat only if baby is settled.
days.afternoon: Berchtesgaden town, nap, hotel pool.
days.baby: Boat is optional; lakefront stroll alone is enough.
days.booking: Check boat schedule and weather the night before.

days.title: Salt mine or Ramsau backup day
days.travel: Local only.
days.morning: Berchtesgaden Salt Mine if baby age rules work; otherwise Ramsau church and easy valley walk.
days.afternoon: Pack, spa/pool, final mountain dinner.
days.baby: Choose the least logistically fussy option after checking rules.
days.booking: Confirm salt mine infant suitability before committing.

days.title: Return to Munich and fly home
days.travel: Berchtesgaden to Munich Airport is about 2-2.5 hours.
days.morning: Drive to airport, return car.
days.afternoon: Fly home.
days.baby: Leave a large airport buffer; this is not a sightseeing day.
days.booking: Book flight after noon if possible.

bookingLinks.label: Flights to Munich
bookingLinks.note: Price from home airport; arrive Sep 4 and depart Sep 16.

bookingLinks.label: Bio-Hotel Stanglwirt
bookingLinks.note: Book 4 nights; request crib and family room.

bookingLinks.label: Kempinski Berchtesgaden
bookingLinks.note: Book 4 nights for Bavaria return base.

trips.name: Banff + Lake Louise
trips.bookability: Strong; lodging and shuttle timing are the critical pieces
trips.positioning: A Canadian Rockies loop with condo practicality, lakefront splurge nights, stroller-friendly walks, and one Jasper/Icefields extension.

bases.name: Calgary airport
bases.reason: Easy arrival reset before driving.

bases.name: Canmore
bases.reason: Kitchen/laundry practicality with fast access to Banff.

bases.name: Lake Louise
bases.reason: Spa, comfort, and village access without paying lakefront every night.

bases.name: Jasper / Icefields
bases.reason: Quieter lake base for wildlife and Icefields Parkway.

bases.name: Banff splurge
bases.reason: End with the iconic lakefront stay and spa moment.

days.title: Fly to Calgary
days.travel: Home airport to Calgary.
days.morning: Fly west; pick flight arriving by afternoon if possible.
days.afternoon: Check in at airport hotel, early dinner, sleep reset.
days.baby: Avoid same-day mountain drive after flight.
days.booking: Book airport hotel and rental car pickup for Sep 4.

days.title: Drive to Canmore and settle in
days.travel: Calgary to Canmore, about 1.25 hours.
days.morning: Pick up rental SUV with car seat; grocery stop.
days.afternoon: Policeman's Creek boardwalk and condo pool/hot tub.
days.baby: Kitchen and laundry begin doing real work.
days.booking: Reserve condo-style unit with crib.

days.title: Banff town and Bow River Pathway
days.travel: Canmore to Banff, 25 minutes each way.
days.morning: Bow River Pathway to Bow Falls; stroller-friendly sections.
days.afternoon: Banff Park Museum or Cave and Basin if weather shifts.
days.baby: Stroller day with carrier backup.
days.booking: Buy park pass; no major reservation needed.

days.title: Johnston Canyon and nap-friendly resort time
days.travel: About 45 minutes each way from Canmore.
days.morning: Johnston Canyon Lower Falls early to avoid crowds.
days.afternoon: Return for nap; Canmore playground/cafe.
days.baby: Carrier better than stroller in canyon crowds.
days.booking: Check Bow Valley Parkway access/transit rules.

days.title: Lake Minnewanka cruise or lakeside picnic
days.travel: Canmore to Lake Minnewanka, about 35 minutes.
days.morning: Lake Minnewanka shore and optional short cruise.
days.afternoon: Two Jack Lake picnic, nap drive, condo downtime.
days.baby: Cruise only if nap schedule cooperates.
days.booking: Reserve cruise with flexible cancellation if chosen.

days.title: Transfer to Lake Louise
days.travel: Canmore to Lake Louise, about 1 hour.
days.morning: Drive after breakfast; Lake Louise village check-in.
days.afternoon: Lake Louise Lakeshore stroller walk.
days.dinner: Post Hotel restaurant or village meal.
days.baby: Short transfer, high scenic payoff.
days.booking: Book Post Hotel 3 nights; request crib.

days.title: Moraine Lake shuttle and Valley of the Ten Peaks
days.travel: Shuttle from Lake Louise area.
days.morning: Moraine Lake shuttle; Rockpile viewpoint with carrier.
days.afternoon: Return for nap; Post Hotel spa turn-taking.
days.baby: Carrier day; avoid overcommitting to longer trails.
days.booking: Reserve Parks Canada/Moraine shuttle as soon as released.

days.title: Yoho day: Emerald Lake and Natural Bridge
days.travel: Lake Louise to Emerald Lake, about 35-45 minutes.
days.morning: Emerald Lake shoreline and Natural Bridge.
days.afternoon: Takakkaw Falls viewpoint if road/access works; otherwise nap and village.
days.baby: Short scenic stops; easy to bail out.
days.booking: Check Yoho road conditions.

days.title: Icefields Parkway to Jasper
days.travel: Lake Louise to Jasper, 3.5 hours driving plus stops.
days.morning: Peyto Lake viewpoint and Waterfowl Lakes stop.
days.afternoon: Athabasca Glacier viewpoint/Columbia Icefield Centre; continue Jasper.
days.baby: Long scenic day broken into many short stops.
days.booking: Skip Ice Explorer unless baby tolerance looks good; book lodge.

days.title: Pyramid Lake and Jasper wildlife loop
days.travel: Local driving.
days.morning: Pyramid Lake shoreline and Patricia Lake.
days.afternoon: Maligne Canyon lower/easy viewpoints; nap back at lodge.
days.baby: Keep wildlife viewing from car/viewpoints.
days.booking: No major bookings.

days.title: Maligne Lake or Jasper slow day
days.travel: Jasper to Maligne Lake, about 50 minutes each way.
days.morning: Maligne Lake shore; optional boat cruise if timing works.
days.afternoon: Return via Medicine Lake; quiet lodge afternoon.
days.baby: Cruise is optional; lakeshore alone is enough.
days.booking: Reserve cruise only after checking weather/nap rhythm.

days.title: Return down Icefields Parkway to Lake Louise splurge
days.travel: Jasper to Lake Louise, 3.5 hours plus stops.
days.morning: Drive south; stop at Sunwapta/Athabasca Falls.
days.afternoon: Check into Fairmont; lakefront walk.
days.baby: Second long drive; end with no further transport.
days.booking: Book Fairmont 2 nights; request crib and early dinner.

days.title: Fairmont lakefront, canoe, and spa
days.travel: No driving required.
days.morning: Lake Louise Lakeshore repeat at sunrise; optional canoe photo moment.
days.afternoon: Fairmont spa / Basin wellness if age/adult access works for parent turns.
days.baby: Best day for minimal logistics and iconic scenery.
days.booking: Prebook spa and dinner.

days.title: Drive to Calgary and fly home
days.travel: Lake Louise to Calgary airport, about 2 hours.
days.morning: Drive to airport and return rental car.
days.afternoon: Fly home.
days.baby: Book afternoon flight; avoid morning rush.
days.booking: Choose departure after 1 pm.

bookingLinks.label: Post Hotel & Spa
bookingLinks.note: Book Lake Louise practical luxury base.

trips.name: Grand Teton + Jackson Hole
trips.bookability: Good; in-park lodging should be booked as soon as dates open
trips.positioning: A domestic national-park plan using Jackson comfort, in-park cabins, a light Yellowstone edge, and baby-friendly lakeside days.

bases.name: Jackson
bases.reason: Walkable first base with restaurants and supplies.

bases.name: Jenny Lake
bases.reason: Splurge cabins at the foot of the Tetons.

bases.name: Jackson Lake / Colter Bay
bases.reason: Central park base with pool, dining, and views.

bases.name: Teton Village
bases.reason: Final comfort base with spa, tram, and easy Jackson access.

days.title: Fly to Jackson
days.travel: Home airport to Jackson Hole Airport; pick up rental car.
days.morning: Fly west with car-seat plan.
days.afternoon: Check in, grocery/snack run, town square stroll.
days.baby: Keep first day in town.
days.booking: Price flights into JAC and backup SLC + drive only if much cheaper.

days.title: Jackson warm-up and wildlife art
days.travel: Local driving.
days.morning: National Museum of Wildlife Art and Elk Refuge area.
days.afternoon: Snow King playground/town time; nap at hotel.
days.baby: Indoor/outdoor mix for acclimation.
days.booking: No major booking.

days.title: Taggart Lake carrier hike
days.travel: Jackson to Taggart trailhead, about 30 minutes.
days.morning: Taggart Lake out-and-back or partial trail with carrier.
days.afternoon: Dornans lunch/view, Moose-Wilson scenic drive if open.
days.baby: Carrier required; turn around early if needed.
days.booking: Check NPS trail/road alerts.

days.title: Move to Jenny Lake Lodge
days.travel: Short drive into park.
days.morning: Check out, scenic stops at Mormon Row and Schwabacher Landing.
days.afternoon: Check into Jenny Lake Lodge; porch and lodge grounds.
days.baby: Short transfer with big views.
days.booking: Book Jenny Lake Lodge as early as reservations allow.

days.title: Jenny Lake boat and Hidden Falls light version
days.travel: Local only.
days.morning: Jenny Lake shuttle boat; Hidden Falls viewpoint if trail conditions suit.
days.afternoon: Nap/lodge; optional short lakeshore walk.
days.baby: Boat can be skipped for a shore walk if needed.
days.booking: Check Jenny Lake boat schedule.

days.title: String Lake picnic and slow cabin day
days.travel: Very short local drive.
days.morning: String Lake shoreline walk/picnic.
days.afternoon: Cabin rest, bikes if lodge provides and baby setup works.
days.baby: Best low-stress nature day.
days.booking: Ask lodge about family bike/seat options, likely skip with one-year-old.

days.title: Move to Jackson Lake Lodge
days.travel: Jenny Lake to Jackson Lake, about 35 minutes without stops.
days.morning: Oxbow Bend wildlife stop, Willow Flats viewpoints.
days.afternoon: Check in, pool, lodge picture windows.
days.dinner: Mural Room or casual lodge dining.
days.baby: Pool/grounds reset after splurge cabin stay.
days.booking: Book cottage room or view upgrade if budget allows.

days.title: Colter Bay and Jackson Lake cruise
days.travel: Local driving.
days.morning: Colter Bay Lakeshore Trail partial walk.
days.afternoon: Optional scenic Jackson Lake cruise; otherwise visitor center and pool.
days.baby: Cruise optional; choose by nap/weather.
days.booking: Reserve cruise with flexible policy.

days.title: Light Yellowstone sampler
days.travel: To West Thumb geyser basin and back, about 2.5-3 hours driving total.
days.morning: Drive north to West Thumb; boardwalk geyser basin.
days.afternoon: Picnic/return; skip deeper Yellowstone.
days.baby: This is the maximum Yellowstone I would do with the current trip shape.
days.booking: Check road status and thermal-area stroller rules.

days.title: Transfer to Teton Village
days.travel: Jackson Lake to Teton Village, about 1 hour.
days.morning: Scenic drive south; optional Chapel of the Transfiguration.
days.afternoon: Check into Teton Village; pool/spa.
days.baby: Final base has more services and comfort.
days.booking: Reserve suite/room with crib.

days.title: Aerial tram and village day
days.travel: Walkable from hotel.
days.morning: Jackson Hole aerial tram/gondola if operating; waffles/view at top if practical.
days.afternoon: Village playground/pool and nap.
days.baby: High-elevation outing is optional and weather-dependent.
days.booking: Check tram operating dates.

days.title: Astoria Hot Springs wellness day
days.travel: Teton Village to Astoria, about 45 minutes.
days.morning: Astoria Hot Springs family soaking session.
days.afternoon: Return for nap; parent spa turn at hotel.
days.baby: Choose a session that matches nap windows.
days.booking: Reserve Astoria session in advance.

days.title: Choose-your-best-repeat day
days.travel: Flexible local driving.
days.morning: Repeat favorite: String Lake, Taggart partial, or Jackson town.
days.afternoon: Pack, pool, easy final dinner.
days.baby: Buffer day prevents the itinerary from becoming brittle.
days.booking: Hold no fixed tickets.

days.title: Fly home from Jackson
days.travel: Teton Village to JAC, about 40 minutes.
days.morning: Return rental car and fly home.
days.afternoon: Travel.
days.baby: Choose midday flight if possible.
days.booking: Book JAC departure; compare SLC only if savings are major.

bookingLinks.label: Grand Teton lodging
bookingLinks.note: Book Jenny Lake and Jackson Lake first.

bases.name: Gleneagles / Perthshire

bases.name: Loch Voil / Trossachs

bases.name: Cairngorms / Braemar
bases.reason: Highland splurge with art, scenery, walks, and weather-proof atmosphere.

bases.name: Edinburgh airport
bases.reason: Easy final night before flying home.

days.title: Fly overnight to Edinburgh
days.travel: Home airport to Edinburgh, likely one connection unless nonstop exists.
days.morning: Depart with baby travel setup.
days.afternoon: Travel day.
days.baby: Price bassinet/extra seat options.
days.booking: Need departure airport; target morning arrival Sep 4.

days.title: Arrive Edinburgh and settle
days.travel: Airport taxi/tram to Old Town.
days.morning: Land, check in/store bags.
days.afternoon: Royal Mile stroller walk only if everyone has energy.
days.dinner: Early Old Town dinner or apartment groceries.
days.baby: Apartment base makes the first night easier.
days.booking: Reserve apartment with crib.

days.title: Edinburgh castle-light day
days.travel: Walking/taxi.
days.morning: Edinburgh Castle exterior/esplanade or timed interior if baby is settled.
days.afternoon: Princes Street Gardens, National Museum of Scotland as rain backup.
days.baby: Use stroller in town but carrier for cobbles/steps.
days.booking: Timed castle tickets only if desired.

days.title: Drive to Gleneagles

days.morning: Rental car pickup and short drive north.
days.afternoon: Estate walk, pool, family activity orientation.
days.baby: Short transfer after city arrival.
days.booking: Book Gleneagles 3 nights; request crib and early dining.

days.title: Gleneagles animals and estate activities
days.travel: On property.
days.morning: Estate walk, horses/stables viewing, family-friendly activity.
days.afternoon: Parent spa turn-taking and pool.
days.baby: High comfort day with little car time.
days.booking: Prebook spa and any family pursuits.

days.title: Loch or castle day from Gleneagles
days.travel: Local drive under 60-90 minutes total.
days.morning: Drummond Castle Gardens or easy Perthshire loch walk.
days.afternoon: Return for nap; pool/spa.
days.baby: Outdoor garden day with indoor resort backup.
days.booking: Check garden opening days.

days.title: Transfer to Monachyle Mhor farm hotel
days.travel: Gleneagles to Loch Voil about 1.5-2 hours.
days.morning: Drive via Callander with cafe/play stop.
days.afternoon: Check in, farm/loch walk, animals.
days.baby: Rural stay gives crawl/play space but confirm room layout.
days.booking: Book 3 nights; ask about farm tour timing.

days.title: Mhor Farm day
days.travel: Minimal.
days.morning: Life at Mhor farm tour if offered; meet goats, donkeys, ponies, Highland cow.
days.afternoon: Loch Voil walk, nap, slow farm afternoon.
days.baby: This is the Scotland trip's best baby-animal day.
days.booking: Reserve farm tour directly if scheduled.

days.title: Trossachs loch and village loop
days.travel: Short scenic drives.
days.morning: Loch Katrine or Callander area easy walk.
days.afternoon: Return to Monachyle for nap and quiet time.
days.baby: Weather-flexible, low-pressure day.
days.booking: Hold no fixed tickets unless choosing a boat cruise.

days.title: Drive to Braemar / Fife Arms
days.travel: Loch Voil to Braemar about 3 hours with stops.
days.morning: Drive northeast; stop for lunch in Pitlochry or Blair Atholl.
days.afternoon: Check into Fife Arms; village stroll.
days.baby: Moderate drive day broken by lunch.
days.booking: Reserve Fife Arms 4 nights; request crib.

days.title: Braemar village and Balmoral area
days.travel: Local driving.
days.morning: Braemar village, river walk, playground/cafe.
days.afternoon: Balmoral estate area if open, or Fife Arms art interiors if rainy.
days.baby: Short local loops with indoor backup.
days.booking: Check Balmoral visitor opening schedule.

days.title: Cairngorms scenic day
days.travel: Braemar to Cairngorms viewpoints/Loch Muick area depending weather.
days.morning: Choose one easy carrier walk: Loch Muick partial or Linn of Dee.
days.afternoon: Return for nap; parent wellness treatment.
days.baby: Carrier day; no summit ambitions.
days.booking: Ask hotel concierge for weather-appropriate family walk.

days.morning: Slow breakfast, pack, final Braemar stroll.
days.afternoon: Drive to airport hotel; return car if evening return works.
days.baby: Final logistics day keeps Sep 16 low-stress.
days.booking: Book airport hotel and car return plan.

days.title: Fly home
days.travel: Airport hotel to terminal.
days.morning: Fly home.
days.afternoon: Travel.
days.baby: Short airport transfer.
days.booking: Choose flight time that avoids a painful early wake if possible.

trips.name: Iceland Farm + South Coast
trips.bookability: Strong; weather-flexible days and child-age spa rules are key
trips.positioning: A compact self-drive route with farms, horses, cows, waterfalls, geothermal pools, and short scenic stops instead of long hikes.

bases.name: Reykjavik
bases.reason: Apartment-style arrival base with kitchen and walkability.

bases.name: Golden Circle farm
bases.reason: Cows, horses, farm restaurant, ice cream, and easy Golden Circle access.

bases.name: South Coast comfort
bases.reason: Comfortable base for waterfalls, black beaches, and weather recovery.

bases.name: Snæfellsnes
bases.reason: Romantic coastal/mountain finale without driving the Ring Road.

days.title: Fly to Reykjavik
days.travel: Home airport to KEF; pick up rental car if arrival timing works.
days.morning: Fly to Iceland.
days.afternoon: Arrive, transfer to Reykjavik, groceries, early sleep.
days.baby: Avoid Blue Lagoon arrival plan; minimum age is an issue for water entry.
days.booking: Price KEF flights and book apartment-style room.

days.title: Reykjavik soft landing
days.travel: Walk/taxi around Reykjavik.
days.morning: Harpa waterfront, Sun Voyager, stroller-friendly city walk.
days.afternoon: Perlan or local pool if family rules work; nap at hotel.
days.baby: City services and apartment reset before rural route.
days.booking: Hold activities flexible.

days.title: Golden Circle to farm hotel
days.travel: Reykjavik to Efstidalur via Thingvellir, about 2 hours driving plus stops.
days.morning: Thingvellir short viewpoints/walks.
days.afternoon: Check into Efstidalur; cows, ice cream, farm dinner.
days.baby: Farm animals immediately make this base worth it.
days.booking: Book farm hotel 4 nights and request crib.

days.title: Geysir, Gullfoss, and farm downtime
days.travel: Short Golden Circle drives.
days.morning: Geysir geothermal area and Gullfoss viewpoints.
days.afternoon: Return for nap, cows/ice cream, short farm walk.
days.baby: Stroller works in some paved areas; carrier for viewpoints.
days.booking: No fixed bookings.

days.title: Secret Lagoon and Fludir food day
days.travel: Efstidalur to Fludir, about 35-45 minutes.
days.morning: Secret Lagoon family soak if child policy and water temperature feel right.
days.afternoon: Fridheimar tomato greenhouse lunch if available; return for nap.
days.baby: Warm-water session should be short and parent-led.
days.booking: Reserve Secret Lagoon and Fridheimar lunch.

days.title: Horse farm and rainy-day buffer
days.travel: Local only.
days.morning: Icelandic horse visit/short viewing experience; skip riding with baby.
days.afternoon: Farm day, nap, nearby cafe or Laugarvatn Fontana parent turns if desired.
days.baby: Animal viewing, not formal riding.
days.booking: Ask hotel for horse/farm visit options.

days.title: Transfer to South Coast
days.travel: Efstidalur to Hotel Ranga via Seljalandsfoss, about 2 hours driving.
days.morning: Drive south; Seljalandsfoss viewpoint, skip slippery behind-falls path with baby.
days.afternoon: Check into Hotel Ranga; nap and river views.
days.baby: Short scenic transfer.
days.booking: Book 4 nights; request crib and early dinner.

days.title: Skogafoss and black sand coast
days.travel: South Coast driving 1.5-2.5 hours total.
days.morning: Skogafoss viewpoint and easy base walk.
days.afternoon: Reynisfjara from safe distance if conditions are calm; Vik cafe stop.
days.dinner: Hotel Ranga or Vik depending timing.
days.baby: Stay far back from sneaker waves; beach is viewing, not playing.
days.booking: Check weather and beach warnings.

days.travel: Long drive to Jokulsarlon is 3.5+ hours each way; only do if baby is thriving.
days.morning: If ambitious: depart early for Jokulsarlon/Diamond Beach. If not: Dyrholaey and Vik slow day.
days.afternoon: Return/nap drive or relaxed hotel day.
days.baby: This is an optional big day; the backup is better for most one-year-old pacing.

days.title: South Coast wellness and weather buffer
days.travel: Local.
days.morning: Lava Centre or easy Hella/Hvolsvollur stops.
days.afternoon: Hotel hot tubs/parent turns, nap, stargazing if awake.
days.baby: Built-in recovery day after waterfall/coast days.
days.booking: Hold flexible.

days.title: Transfer to Snæfellsnes
days.travel: Hotel Ranga to Budir about 4 hours plus stops.
days.morning: Drive via Reykjavik lunch/grocery break.
days.afternoon: Arrive Hotel Budir; black church/coast walk.
days.baby: Longest drive; break in Reykjavik.
days.booking: Book 3 nights at Hotel Budir.

days.title: Snæfellsnes coast and mountain views
days.travel: Scenic peninsula loop in pieces.
days.morning: Arnarstapi short coastal walk with carrier.
days.afternoon: Kirkjufell viewpoint, cafe stops, nap drive.
days.baby: Short walks only; dramatic cliffs need carrier and caution.
days.booking: No fixed bookings.

days.title: Snæfellsnes buffer and final cozy dinner
days.travel: Local.
days.morning: Choose favorite repeat: beach/viewpoint, horse viewing, or quiet hotel morning.
days.afternoon: Pack, nap, final coast walk.
days.baby: Buffer day absorbs bad weather elsewhere.
days.booking: Reserve dinner.

days.title: Drive to KEF and fly home
days.travel: Budir to KEF about 3 hours; return rental car.
days.morning: Early drive to airport.
days.afternoon: Fly home.
days.baby: Book afternoon departure if possible.
days.booking: Avoid early-morning departure from Snæfellsnes.

trips.name: Alaska Kenai + Anchorage
trips.bookability: Moderate; seasonal closings and lodge logistics need confirmation
trips.positioning: A big-scenery Alaska plan that avoids overreaching: Anchorage, Girdwood, Seward, Homer-area splurge, and a glacier finale.

bases.name: Anchorage
bases.reason: Arrival base with city services and easy supply run.

bases.name: Girdwood
bases.reason: Mountain resort, tram, spa, wildlife center access.

bases.name: Seward
bases.reason: Practical harbor base for Kenai Fjords and SeaLife Center.

bases.name: Homer / Halibut Cove
bases.reason: Wellness, farm-to-table, and special Alaska lodge experience.

bases.name: Knik Glacier / Palmer
bases.reason: Glacier-view finale near Anchorage, if open through Sep 15.

days.title: Fly to Anchorage
days.travel: Home airport to Anchorage; pick up rental car if arrival is not too late.
days.morning: Fly west/north.
days.afternoon: Arrive, check in, groceries, early dinner.
days.baby: Protect first night; time-zone shift can be rough.
days.booking: Need departure airport; book AWD/SUV rental.

days.title: Anchorage recovery and wildlife intro
days.travel: Local Anchorage driving.
days.morning: Alaska Zoo or Potter Marsh boardwalk depending weather.
days.afternoon: Anchorage Museum / nap / supply run.
days.baby: Urban backup day before longer drives.
days.booking: No fixed bookings.

days.title: Drive Turnagain Arm to Girdwood
days.travel: Anchorage to Girdwood, about 1 hour plus scenic stops.
days.morning: Beluga Point and Turnagain Arm viewpoints.
days.afternoon: Check into Alyeska; pool/spa/tram area.
days.baby: Short scenic transfer.
days.booking: Book Alyeska 3 nights; request crib.

days.title: Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center
days.travel: Girdwood to AWCC, about 20 minutes.
days.morning: Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center.
days.afternoon: Portage area viewpoint or resort nap/spa.
days.baby: Excellent stroller/car wildlife day.
days.booking: Buy AWCC tickets if required.

days.title: Alyeska tram and wellness day
days.travel: On property.
days.morning: Alyeska aerial tram if weather is clear.
days.afternoon: Nordic spa parent turns or pool/rest.
days.baby: Weather-dependent summit; no pressure.
days.booking: Prebook spa if choosing it.

days.title: Drive to Seward
days.travel: Girdwood to Seward, about 2 hours.
days.morning: Drive after breakfast; scenic stops at Moose Pass/Trail Lake.
days.afternoon: Check in, Seward harbor walk.
days.baby: Harbor walk is easy and flexible.
days.booking: Book harbor-view room if budget allows.

days.title: Alaska SeaLife Center and Exit Glacier
days.travel: Local Seward driving.
days.morning: Alaska SeaLife Center.
days.afternoon: Exit Glacier accessible viewpoints/short trail if conditions work.
days.baby: Great indoor/outdoor mix.
days.booking: Book SeaLife Center timed tickets if needed.

days.title: Kenai Fjords gentle cruise decision day
days.travel: Boat or local only.
days.morning: If seas/weather are calm, take the shortest wildlife/glacier cruise suitable for baby; otherwise Lowell Point beach and town.
days.afternoon: Nap, harbor, playground/cafe.
days.baby: Do not pre-commit to a long rough-water cruise.
days.booking: Hold cruise as flexible/refundable; ask operator about infants.

days.title: Drive to Homer / Stillpoint transfer
days.travel: Seward to Homer area is about 4.5 hours plus stops; Stillpoint requires water taxi/transfer planning.
days.morning: Drive west with Soldotna/Kenai stop.
days.afternoon: Arrive Homer, transfer/check in as arranged.
days.baby: This is a big logistics day; only worth it if lodge confirms baby-friendly transfers.
days.booking: Confirm Stillpoint availability, transfer, crib, and child policy before committing.

days.title: Stillpoint wellness and farm-to-table day
days.travel: On/near property.
days.morning: Slow lodge breakfast, garden/farm-to-table orientation, coastal views.
days.afternoon: Wellness/massage parent turns, nap, easy shoreline time.
days.baby: The Alaska equivalent of a special resort/farm stay.
days.booking: Prebook wellness treatments.

days.title: Kachemak Bay slow exploration
days.travel: Local lodge-arranged outing only.
days.morning: Short guided nature walk or beach exploration.
days.afternoon: Nap, lodge time, optional gentle boat transfer only if conditions are calm.
days.baby: Keep outing short and lodge-led.
days.booking: Arrange baby-appropriate activity with lodge.

days.title: Transfer to Knik Glacier / Palmer
days.travel: Homer to Palmer/Knik area is long, about 5+ hours; consider breaking in Anchorage if needed.
days.morning: Early transfer back to car; drive north.
days.afternoon: Arrive Alaska Glacier Lodge; quiet cabin evening.
days.baby: Hardest drive day; backup is Anchorage overnight instead.
days.booking: Confirm lodge is open through Sep 15 and room is baby-appropriate.

days.title: Knik Glacier finale
days.travel: Local lodge activity.
days.morning: Glacier flightseeing or ground-view activity only if infant policy, weather, and comfort align.
days.afternoon: Pack, lodge views, early dinner.
days.baby: Flightseeing is optional; glacier-view lodge day still works.
days.booking: Confirm infant rules for any flightseeing or glacier tour.

days.title: Return to Anchorage and fly home
days.travel: Knik/Palmer to Anchorage airport, about 1-1.5 hours.
days.morning: Drive to ANC, return car.
days.afternoon: Fly home.
days.baby: Book afternoon/evening departure to reduce rush.
days.booking: Avoid too-early flight from Palmer/Knik.

bookingLinks.label: Stillpoint Lodge
bookingLinks.note: Confirm September availability, child policy, and transfers.
